protocol.decisionTiming: Receipt time of in-window observations; no inherited history or intents; five-observation in-window warmup
protocol.fillTiming: Later usable REST snapshot after modeled latency; within intent expiry and decision limit
protocol.exitTiming: Existing mean recovery/stop loss/ten-minute exit rule; later bid/depth required; no fabricated terminal sale
protocol.benchmark: No trade and independent small buy-and-hold control for every variant
protocol.depth: One-use source version per strategy; prespecified displayed-depth haircut
protocol.costs: Spread plus adverse tick and fees; all assumptions explicitly unverified
protocol.inference: All variants reported; 100 completed trades is only a review threshold, not sufficient proof of profitability or independence
protocol.review: Independent review required; exact source prefix/config/plan hashes retained; incomplete windows labeled
protocol.promotion: No automatic strategy selection or competition activation
protocol.priorData: All pre-window captures used only for exploration; never labeled held out
